## Core service 1: CA Firm in Chennai
- URL: https://www.csrushil.com/
- Summary: A CA firm in Chennai handling Private Limited Company registration, GST and GST litigation, income tax, statutory and tax audit, ROC compliance and virtual CFO services for businesses, professionals and NRIs.
- Who it serves: founders and startups, SMEs and traders, manufacturers and exporters, foreign-owned subsidiaries, HNIs and NRIs.
- Chennai areas served: 18, listed on the homepage, https://www.csrushil.com/#areas

## Core service 2: Private Limited Company Registration in Chennai
- URL: https://www.csrushil.com/private-limited-company-incorporation-chennai
- Summary: SPICe+ incorporation under the Companies Act, 2013, recorded with the Registrar of Companies, Chennai.
- Typical time: 7–12 working days once documents and DSCs are ready; about 3 weeks from scratch.
- Requirements: 2 directors and 2 shareholders (can be the same people); at least one director resident in India for at least 182 days during the financial year (Section 149(3), Companies Act, 2013); no minimum paid-up capital.
- Registrar: ROC Chennai, Shastri Bhavan, 26 Haddows Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai, for Chennai and most of Tamil Nadu; ROC Coimbatore for nine western districts. SPICe+ forms are examined by the MCA Central Registration Centre.
- Government charges (authorised capital up to ₹15 lakh): MCA filing fee zero; Tamil Nadu stamp duty ₹200 on the MoA plus ₹500 per ₹10 lakh of authorised capital (or part) on the AoA; PAN ₹66 and TAN ₹65; DSCs priced by the Certifying Authority; ₹1,000 only if the name is reserved separately in SPICe+ Part A.
- Common resubmission triggers: registered office proof (EB bill, property tax receipt) in a name other than the NOC signatory; PAN and Aadhaar details that do not match; generic main objects; names close to existing companies or trademarks.

## Core service 3: Virtual CFO in Chennai
- URL: https://www.csrushil.com/virtual-cfo-services
- Summary: CA-led outsourced and fractional CFO services, delivered part-time from the Anna Nagar office.
- Startups: burn rate and runway models, unit economics (CAC, LTV), investor MIS, ESOP and cap-table hygiene, DPIIT and FEMA (FC-GPR) tracking.
- SMEs and manufacturers (₹5 crore to ₹100 crore turnover): working capital and debtor days, SKU and plant costing, CMA data for bank facilities, internal controls, GST and TDS cash-flow mapping.
- Foreign-owned subsidiaries: monthly group reporting with Ind AS to IFRS or US GAAP bridge, transfer pricing margin monitoring for Form 3CEB, RBI FLA and FEMA calendar.
- First 90 days: days 1–30 chart of accounts cleanup and reconciliation; days 31–60 first MIS pack and 13-week cash-flow forecast; days 61–90 budget vs actual cadence and board packs.
- Tools: Zoho Books, Tally Prime, QuickBooks, Xero, RazorpayX and Cashfree reconciliation, Keka and Zoho Payroll, Power BI and Looker Studio.

## Core service 4: GST Litigation & Appeals in Chennai
- URL: https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-chennai
- Summary: Representation as authorised representative under Section 116 of the CGST Act before GST officers, the Appellate Authority and the GST Appellate Tribunal.
- Covers: DRC-01A and DRC-01 notices under Sections 73, 74 and 74A (replies in DRC-06); ASMT-10 scrutiny; Section 16(4), 16(5) and 16(6) ITC time-bar disputes; Section 129 detentions (MOV-06, MOV-07, MOV-09); registration cancellation (REG-17, REG-19) and revocation (REG-21).
- First appeal: Form APL-01 within 3 months of the order, with the admitted amount and 10% of disputed tax as pre-deposit.
- Second appeal: Form APL-05 to the GSTAT State Bench (Tamil Nadu benches sit at Chennai, Coimbatore and Madurai) within 3 months, with a further 10%.
- Chennai forums: CGST Chennai North, South and Outer Commissionerates; Commissioner (Appeals-I), Nungambakkam and (Appeals-II), Newry Towers, Anna Nagar; Tamil Nadu Commercial Taxes Department, Nandanam; Appellate Deputy Commissioners (ST), Greams Road; GSTAT Chennai State Bench.
- Early-stage notice replies (before a demand): https://www.csrushil.com/gst-notice-reply-chennai

## Engagement process and independence
- URL: https://www.csrushil.com/how-we-work
- Steps: first contact (WhatsApp, call or booking), 15-minute consultation with a chartered accountant, conflict and independence check, scoping call, written proposal and engagement letter, onboarding, ongoing work.
- Independence: the firm does not act as statutory auditor of a company for which it keeps the books, prepares financial statements or acts as virtual CFO (Section 144, Companies Act, 2013).
- Cross-border: Indian law and Indian filings only; coordinates with the client's overseas accountant or lawyer. Clients outside Chennai and abroad are served online from the Anna Nagar office.

## Professional standards
- The firm follows ICAI guidelines: professional fees are not published on the website, and there is no rating markup. Government fees are listed where they are public facts.

## Outsourced bookkeeping (US, UK, Singapore, Australia, UAE, India)
Bookkeeping is kept from the Chennai office in the client's own software. Outside India the firm prepares figures only; the client or its locally registered accountant, BAS agent or tax agent files with the IRS, HMRC, IRAS/ACRA, ATO or UAE FTA. In India the firm files GST, TDS, ROC and income tax returns directly. No published price lists; fees are quoted after a review of the books.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping Services from India](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-services): How offshore bookkeeping works, who files what in each country, cost drivers, outsourced vs in-house, and who it does not suit.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for US Small Businesses](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-usa): QuickBooks Online and Xero monthly close, catch-up clean-ups, 1099-NEC/MISC tracking at the $2,000 threshold for 2026 payments, sales tax data and a CPA-ready year-end package; the client's CPA or EA files.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for UK Businesses](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-uk): Xero, QuickBooks, FreeAgent and Sage bookkeeping, nine-box VAT figures and MTD for Income Tax records (from 6 April 2026 above £50,000); the client or its UK agent submits to HMRC. UK GDPR transfer via IDTA or UK Addendum.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for Singapore Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-singapore): Xero, QuickBooks and Zoho Books bookkeeping, GST F5 figures (registration above S$1 million, 9%), multi-currency revaluation and SFRS year-end books; the tax agent and corporate secretary file with IRAS and ACRA.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for Australian Businesses](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-australia): Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks bookkeeping, payroll and super reconciliations under Payday Super (from 1 July 2026) and EOFY handover. Not TPB-registered: BAS is lodged by the client's registered BAS or tax agent.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for Dubai & UAE Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-bookkeeping-uae): IFRS bookkeeping in Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero or Tally, VAT figures by emirate, Corporate Tax-ready books (9% above AED 375,000), first-period rebuilds and e-invoicing readiness; the client's FTA-registered tax agent files on EmaraTax.
- [Bookkeeping Services in Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/bookkeeping-services-chennai): Tally Prime and Zoho Books bookkeeping, GST and TDS filing, MIS, audit-trail (edit log) compliance and 8-year retention under Section 128; the firm does not audit companies whose books it keeps.

## ROC compliance calendar (companies and LLPs registered with ROC Chennai)
- Page: https://www.csrushil.com/roc-compliances
- Company, 31 March year end: AGM within 6 months (by 30 September); ADT-1 within 15 days, AOC-4 within 30 days and MGT-7/MGT-7A within 60 days of the AGM; DPT-3 by 30 June; MSME-1 by 30 April and 31 October where dues to micro and small suppliers exceed 45 days; DIR-3 KYC Web once every three financial years by 30 June.
- LLP: Form 11 by 30 May; Form 8 by 30 October.
- Late fee ₹100 per day per form; Section 164(2) disqualification after three continuous years of non-filing.
